scope: Every LLMPoetry project turn in all cases: poetry, refactor, validation, discussion, packaging, evaluation, and housekeeping.
requirement: Perform a web research pulse before substantive action and log it in packaged revisions; a packaged revision must contain a pulse for its current revision/turn.
blocked_behavior: If host or user blocks browsing, log WEB-PULSE-BLOCKED and downgrade currentness/source claims.
package_gate: make doctor must run check_research_pulses.py; a missing pulse for the current completed turn blocks release.
